name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A popover-style date field that combines a text input and a calendar for selecting a date.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description:
Whether the calendar should close after the date selection is complete.
This is ignored when the selection mode is `multiple`.

props.name: createCalendar
props.description:
A function that creates a Calendar object for a given calendar identifier.
Enables non-Gregorian calendar support (Persian, Buddhist, Islamic, etc.)
without bundling all calendars by default.

props.name: defaultFocusedValue
props.description:
Initial visible-month focus, as an ISO date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
Pins the SSR-rendered month instead of falling back to the browser's
wall-clock "today" (`getTodayDate`), which would otherwise make SSR
and hydrated markup diverge near midnight or across timezones.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the date picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the date picker.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected date(s) when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected date(s) of the date picker.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The default view of the calendar

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the calendar is disabled.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description:
Whether the calendar should have a fixed number of weeks.
This renders the calendar with 6 weeks instead of 5 or 6.

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: Controlled visible-month focus, as an ISO date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

props.name: format
props.description: The format of the date to display in the input.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the date picker. Useful for composition.

props.name: inline
props.description: Whether to render the date picker inline

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the date picker is invalid

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Returns whether a date of the calendar is available.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale (BCP 47 language tag) to use when formatting the date.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum date that can be selected.

props.name: maxSelectedDates
props.description:
The maximum number of dates that can be selected.
This is only applicable when `selectionMode` is `multiple`.

props.name: maxView
props.description: The maximum view of the calendar

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum date that can be selected.

props.name: minView
props.description: The minimum view of the calendar

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the input element.

props.name: numOfMonths
props.description: The number of months to display.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the date picker

props.name: openOnClick
props.description: Whether to open the calendar when the input is clicked.

props.name: outsideDaySelectable
props.description: Whether day outside the visible range can be selected.

props.name: parse
props.type: ((value: string, details: LocaleDetails) => DateValue | undefined) | undefined
props.description: Function to parse the date from the input back to a DateValue.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text to display in the input.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the date picker content

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the calendar is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the date picker is required

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
The selection mode of the calendar.
- `single` - only one date can be selected
- `multiple` - multiple dates can be selected
- `range` - a range of dates can be selected

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: Whether to show the week number column in the day view.

props.name: startOfWeek
props.description:
The first day of the week.
 `0` - Sunday
 `1` - Monday
 `2` - Tuesday
 `3` - Wednesday
 `4` - Thursday
 `5` - Friday
 `6` - Saturday

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The time zone to use

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected date as an ISO date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

props.name: view
props.description: The view of the calendar

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Function called when the focused date changes.

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the calendar opens or closes.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function called when the value changes.

events.name: onViewChange
events.description: Function called when the view changes.

events.name: onVisibleRangeChange
events.description: Function called when the visible range changes.

events.name: valueChange
events.description: Function called when the value changes. Receives the new ISO date string, or `undefined` when cleared.

keyboard.description: Moves focus between the text input and the calendar-trigger button, then into the open calendar panel.
Opens the calendar panel when the trigger button is focused; selects the focused day when a day cell is focused.
Moves focus one day at a time within the calendar grid (composed examples get this from `Calendar`).
Moves focus to the same day in the previous/next month.
Moves focus to the first/last day of the visible week.
Closes the calendar panel without changing the value.

accessibilityNotes: The text input and the calendar trigger button share one `data-slot="date-picker-control"` group; typing a valid date and picking one from the calendar both update the same controlled `value`.

The calendar panel is a popover (`role` and `aria-expanded` on the trigger button come from `@zag-js/date-picker`'s `getTriggerProps()`), so it's reachable and dismissible with the same keyboard model as `Popover`.

Day cells expose `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled` via `getDayTableCellTriggerProps()`; the composed `Popover`+`Calendar` examples (range, dropdown, input-sync) get the same semantics from `Calendar` directly.
Set `disabled` to remove the whole field from the tab order, or `readOnly` to keep the value visible and focusable while blocking changes from both the input and the calendar.

examples.source:

{ value = next ?? ""; } /> value: ${value || "none"}

composition:
`<DatePicker>` is a complete, self-contained field (input + trigger + calendar) built on `@zag-js/date-picker` — reach for it first. For anything it doesn't cover (a date range, a dropdown month/year caption, syncing a free-text input), compose `Popover` and `Calendar` directly, the same way upstream does:

```text
Popover
├── @trigger (render-prop)
└── (body)
    └── Calendar
```

`Popover`'s `@trigger` receives the machine's trigger props to spread onto any element (a `Button`, an `InputGroupButton`…), and the tag's own body holds whatever should render inside the positioned panel — typically a `Calendar`. See the Popover and Calendar pages for their full APIs.
